newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Securities says short of Yaohan shares.
newsitem.headline: Japan Securities says short of Yaohan shares.

text.p: Japan Securities Finance Co Ltd said on Wednesday that it has issued a "warning" that it may run short of shares in Yaohan Japan Corp to lend for margin trade.
Japan Securities Finance lends shares and money to brokerages for margin trade with Finance Ministry authorisation.
The warning does not mean that Japan Securities will immediately stop lending cash stocks of Yaohan Japan to investors who wish to short the stock in margin trade.
The statement indicates, however, that Japan Securities could be forced to stop lending the shares in the future as it is facing a shortage of cash stocks in Yaohan Japan.
